description: This file defines the CobaltTextToSpeechHelper class, which implements text-to-speech functionality and accessibility event handling for audio accessibility features in the Cobalt project. It manages a singleton TTS engine, handles screen reader state changes, and provides methods for speaking and canceling speech.

classes.name: CobaltTextToSpeechHelper
classes.description: Helper class implementing text-to-speech and accessibility state change handling for audio accessibility.

methods.name: CobaltTextToSpeechHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper, setting up handler thread, and registering accessibility listeners.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the TTS engine, stops the handler thread, and removes accessibility listeners.

methods.name: isScreenReaderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a screen reader is currently enabled.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for TTS engine initialization; processes pending utterances if successful.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Speaks the provided text, enqueuing if necessary, using the TTS engine.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Stops all ongoing speech and clears pending utterances.

methods.name: onAccessibilityStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in accessibility state, triggers event if screen reader state changes.

methods.name: onTouchExplorationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in touch exploration (talkback) state, triggers event if changed.

methods.name: finishIfScreenReaderChanged
methods.description: Checks if screen reader state has changed and sends event if so.

methods.name: nativeSendTTSChangedEvent
methods.description: Native method called when TTS or accessibility state changes.
